Name: (AT) Inherited Barn Coop and Shed
Author: schmegaman
Description:
Adds grungy, rustic-looking barns, coops and sheds. Requires Alternative Textures. Sister mod to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35276](AT) Inherited Farmhouse & Furniture.[/url]

Thank you for the support on my farmhouse mod! ^_^ I said I was going to put out a matching farm buildings mod, which I'm still working on, but I'm not sure how long it'll take for me to release... So I figured I would release what I have early.

In the meantime if you want other similar-looking farm buildings for the silo, well, etc. check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22363](AT) Ali's Modern Farm Buildings[/url] !
